title: arctostaphylos crustacea subsp. tomentosiformis
intro: Arctostaphylos crustacea subsp. tomentosiformis, commonly known as Island Bearberry, is a species of flowering plant in the heath family, Ericaceae. This shrub, native to the Channel Islands in California, has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Island Bearberry include antimicrobial, antifungal, and antiviral activities, which may aid in the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of Island Bearberry include arbutin, hydroquinone, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
